talking-to-osmumten-for-the-first-time.text: As you approach the spirit, you hear a voice echoing in your head.

talking-to-osmumten-for-the-first-time.npc: You. You fought against the Devourer. Her influence here has been lessened as a result. You are to be commended for your strength.
Once, but who I was in life means nothing. Vengeance is all that matters now. The Devourer may be gone, but my home has been corrupted. This corruption must be destroyed.
You can. Take your prize and leave, but when you are ready, return here. The Devourer's thralls will soon be back. You must fight them.
We shall see if it is enough.

talking-to-osmumten-for-the-first-time.prompt: Are you ready to leave the Tombs of Amascut?

talking-to-osmumten-afterwards.text: If the player did not claim their rewards yet:

steps.npc: The Devourer's thralls will be back, but they have been weakened because of you. Your prize awaits.

talking-to-osmumten-afterwards.text: If the player claimed their rewards:

steps.npc: You have done well, but it is time for you to leave. The Devourer's thralls will soon return.
You fought well. The Devourer's influence here has lessened, but it will soon be restored. It is time for you to leave.
The Devourer's thralls will be back, but they have been weakened because of you. Now, leave this place.

talking-to-osmumten-afterwards.prompt: Are you ready to leave the Tombs of Amascut?

steps.text: Player gets teleported to the Tombs of Amascut lobby.

talking-to-osmumten-after-defeating-a-de.npc: We are done here, but the Devourer's thralls are everywhere. They must be removed.

talking-to-osmumten-after-defeating-a-de.text: The player gets relocated to the tombs' nexus.
